provenance.source: btap-necb umbrella pipeline self-declaration — the compliance determination itself (Part 8 Section 8.4). 2025 renumbering: the reference-building subsection is 8.4.5 (2020: 8.4.4); 8.4.4 is the NEW Energy Use Intensity path, which exists only here and only in this gem (tiers.rb).
provenance.note: This file carries ONLY article_coverage — the umbrella has no rule data of its own (verdicts and iteration logic live in compliance.rb; EUI arithmetic in tiers.rb reads eui_targets_2025.json).

articles.title: Determination of Compliance
articles.how: The pipeline computes the (2) annual-energy verdict (against the 8.4.4 EUI target or the 8.4.5 reference building), the (3)/(4) unmet-hours verdicts (with the vacuous-cooling determination when the proposed has no mechanical cooling), and the sentence-(5) capacity auto-iteration — per-thermal-block: each failing zone’s Sizing:Zone factors are raised, secant-targeted from that zone’s own (factor, unmet-hours) history across rounds, with a global SizingParameters fallback when per-zone data cannot attribute the failure, and hard-sized-equipment stall detection — compliance.rb; asserted by test_compliance.rb.

articles.title: Treatment of Process Loads
articles.how: (2): on the reference path, process loads in the proposed are automatically in the reference (clone; no transform touches them). On the EUI path the PL term is the caller-supplied process_loads_kwh added to the BET (8.4.4.1.(2)). (1) exclusion-by-default is the modeller's input decision.

articles.title: General
articles.how: Compliance is assessed through modeling: the umbrella is the only gem permitted to run EnergyPlus, and a determination requires sizing + annual runs (simulate: :annual); any other mode is flagged non-determining. The EUI path still requires the annual run of the proposed.

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.how: the energy model accounts for the annual energy use of what the model contains
articles.gaps: elevators/escalators ((1)(j)) and other loads absent from the model are not added by the pipeline

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.how: annual 8760-hour runs at an hourly timestep; a shortened run_period computes the arithmetic but is flagged NOT code-compliant and exits as no-determination

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.how: operating schedules and climatic data enter at an hourly interval

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.how: software conformance rests on EnergyPlus’s ANSI/ASHRAE 140 testing (see 8.4.2.11.)

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.gaps: excluding redundant/back-up equipment is a modeller decision about the model’s contents; the pipeline cannot know which equipment is redundant

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.gaps: routing un-modelable systems through an 8.4.2.12. exceptional calculation method is a modeller decision

articles.title: Climatic Data
articles.how: weather attach (CWEC EPW + DDY design days) via OpenStudioSimulation::Runner.attach_weather!; HDD resolution: explicit arg -> Table C-1 -> .stat fallback

articles.title: Climatic Data
articles.gaps: the choice among multiple urban climatic data sets is the modeller’s; the pipeline attaches exactly the file it is given

articles.title: General (Proposed Building)
articles.how: The proposed model is simulated as supplied — the pipeline applies no transforms to it (weather attach only); reference transforms operate on a clone. Guaranteed by test_caller_model_never_mutated (test_compliance.rb).

articles.title: General (Energy Use Intensity path)
articles.how: BET = sum(A_i x EUI_i) + PL from Table 8.4.4.1 (tiers.rb) with archetype floor areas COMPUTED FROM THE MODEL per (3) (Archetypes.resolve: partofTotalFloorArea non-plenum spaces x multiplier, a documented proxy for "conditioned"); (4) unmapped space functions distributed pro-rata (Archetypes.bet_areas — over-assignment impossible by construction); (1) coverage >= 90% and the Table-note HDD < 9000 bound are HARD refusals on the :eui path (a verdict outside applicability is not a determination); unknown archetype names raise.

articles.title: Operating Schedules, Internal Loads and Service Water Heating Loads (EUI path)
articles.how: check-then-normalize (Archetypes.conformance / normalize!): the proposed is checked against the Table 8.4.4.2. values (occupant density, receptacle W/m2, SWH L/h/occupant; schedule profiles compared hourly against the archetype letter) and, when non-conformant, REWRITTEN to them before the EUI-path annual run
articles.gaps: unmapped spaces keep their modeled loads (the Table applies “for the applicable building archetype”); spaces with no water-use equipment warn rather than gaining a SWH system

articles.title: Operating Schedules, Internal Loads and Service Water Heating Loads (EUI path)
articles.how: peak outdoor air ventilation rates stay at the proposed building’s specified values — normalization does not touch OA
